## rotateWaDataSourceSecret

Rotate Wa Flow Data Source Secret. `POST /whatsapp-flow-data-sources/{data_source_id}/rotate-secret`

Generate a new signing secret; returned ONCE as signing_secret.

The replaced secret stays valid for 24h (previous_secret_expires_at): until then each request carries two v1 signatures (new + old) so the receiver can switch over without dropped requests. Rotating again inside the window retires the older secret immediately.

## estimateAiGeneration

Estimate Ai Generation. `POST /whatsapp-flows/ai/estimate`

AI credits a generation will cost, shown before the user confirms.

## cancelAiJob

Cancel Ai Job. `POST /whatsapp-flows/ai/jobs/{job_id}/cancel`

Cancel a queued/running generate/refine job (works from any pod).

An active job becomes failed with error.code = "cancelled"; no further AI calls or repair rounds start. A cancelled job is never charged (from 2026-11-01 usage_billed true, credits_charged 0). Idempotent. A job that already finished (or is committing its result) is returned unchanged — a succeeded job stays succeeded. Another workspace's job is a 404.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppFlows()->cancelAiJob(jobId: 'job_id');
```

- Scopes: `whatsapp_flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$jobId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Job`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Flows/cancel_ai_job_api_v1_whatsapp_flows_ai_jobs__job_id__cancel_post)

## publishPublication

Publish Publication. `POST /whatsapp-flows/publications/{publication_id}/publish`

## cloneWa

Clone Wa Flow. `POST /whatsapp-flows/{definition_id}/clone`

Copy the current version into a new flow (same or sibling workspace).

Cross-workspace copies are limited to the same billing account and need whatsapp_flows:write in the target workspace (checked by the service). API keys may only copy into another workspace when the key itself holds tenants:manage; OAuth apps may only copy within the current workspace.

```php
$sendseven->whatsAppFlows()->cloneWa(definitionId: 'definition_id');
```

- Scopes: `whatsapp_flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$definitionId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$body` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Flows/clone_wa_flow_api_v1_whatsapp_flows__definition_id__clone_post)

## previewWaData

Preview Wa Flow Data. `POST /whatsapp-flows/{definition_id}/preview-data`

Entry-screen data a send would carry, per key with its source (nothing is sent).

Same resolve + merge as a real send: initial_data (override) > saved channel defaults > send-time bindings incl. default prefill > __example__. Without contact_id no contact data is resolved (examples only). Values coming from the contact are returned verbatim, never template-rendered.

```php
$sendseven->whatsAppFlows()->previewWaData(definitionId: 'definition_id');
```

- Scopes: `whatsapp_flows:read`, `contacts:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$definitionId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$contactId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$initialData` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Per-send overrides (any data key, e.g. __prefill_<name>); win over everything. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Flows/preview_wa_flow_data_api_v1_whatsapp_flows__definition_id__preview_data_post)

## getWaReferences

Get Wa Flow References. `GET /whatsapp-flows/{definition_id}/references`

Where this WhatsApp Flow is used (archive / publish-changes dialogs).

* automations -- Send WhatsApp Flow nodes (and form-completed triggers, node_id: "trigger") of this workspace's automations that reference it. * templates -- WhatsApp templates whose FLOW button opens one of its Meta flows (current, still-live and superseded ids), ANY status (the retirement check only counts APPROVED/PENDING -- template_refs_for_meta_flows). * scheduled_sends_count -- scheduled sends never reference a flow definition directly (they go through templates), so this is 0.

```php
$sendseven->whatsAppFlows()->getWaReferences(definitionId: 'definition_id');
```

- Scopes: `whatsapp_flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$definitionId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Flows/get_wa_flow_references_api_v1_whatsapp_flows__definition_id__references_get)

## sendWa

Send Wa Flow. `POST /whatsapp-flows/{definition_id}/send`

Send a published flow to a contact (interactive inside 24h, or via an approved template).

initial_data string values may use contact variables ({{contact.first_name}}, {{contact.email}}, {{contact.custom.<key>}}, ...); they are rendered for the recipient before sending. Draft flows cannot be sent (draft_send_not_supported).

```php
$sendseven->whatsAppFlows()->sendWa(definitionId: 'definition_id');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`, `whatsapp_flows:read`

| `$conversationId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$mode` | `?string` | no | 'interactive' (inside 24h window) or 'template' |
| `$screen` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$initialData` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Entry-screen data. String values may contain contact variables such as {{contact.first_name}} or {{contact.custom.<key>}}, rendered per recipient. |
| `$headerText` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$bodyText` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$footerText` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$cta` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$templateId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$templateVariables` | `mixed` | no |  |
| `$draft` | `?bool` | no |  |
